correctness.rationale: Each update reduces relevant prefix length by one until the first-letter subspace. The reduced loopless complete NOR map permutes the zero/one pair, fixes each singleton and sends every other nonuniform vector to zero. Periodicity forces membership in the image after d−1 steps; a specified two-one vector is attainable then by disjoint, individually surjective NOR trees (including height 0), hence realizes T=d. Initial leaves of distinct prefix evaluations have distinct suffixes, while leaves within a root are indexed by all admissible prepended strings, once each. Independence and equal bias therefore give the stated CDF as the disjoint probabilities of two uniform outcomes and q+1 single-block outcomes; at t=d−1 only one-hot outputs reach a fixed point. Exact integer counts use B_t and S_t as leaf counts. For the critical limit, differentiation of J(s) gives the sign of sum_{j=0}^{q−1} s^(−j)−q², strictly falling from +infinity to q−q². With endpoint limits 1 and 0 this establishes precisely one interior crossing of 1; monotone even iterates converge to opposite endpoints on either side, and p=p_* is stationary. The basin limit is (q+1)p_*² there, including the stated endpoint cases off criticality.
residual_risks: Fresh checks use indegree-stripping rather than assuming period ≤2; they cover 6 cases up to (4,2), checking p=1/2,1/3,4/5 by exact weights. All-size conclusions come from the proof, not the enumeration. The critical limit is not uniform in p and does not cover correlated inputs.

evidence: Classical Kautz words shift with adjacent equal letters forbidden; unlike the full de Bruijn alphabet this makes the first-letter update loopless. The Kautz XOR record 165ad680a86f is outgoing XOR and its Jordan structure is not a NOR attractor theorem.

value.rationale: Kautz is a standard directed network, and the effect of deleting same-letter transitions is qualitative: a uniform oscillator acquires q+1 coexisting fixed phases. The exact first-entry and individual-basin laws, and the isolated critical survival limit, measure the effect for all alphabets and depths and are useful beyond the elementary NOR-tree recursion.
residual_risks: No universality across graph families, other update rules, or critical scaling window claimed.
